# FTDI D2XX 1.4.6

This directory contains the FTDI D2XX Linux x86_64 runtime used and
tested with AMBEd.

## Included runtime

Architecture: x86_64
Version: 1.4.6

SHA-256:

5d6f7028f8e5574ae91947a5ce976b35875c2eb37b8deb53640ef82e70d0b834  libftd2xx.so.1.4.6

This exact runtime has been tested with:

- DVstick-33 / AMBE3003
- USB-3000 / AMBE3000
- Linux Mint 22.3
- AMBEd 1.3.5
- Four simultaneous codec channels
